subject: Discovery -> Pilot Handshake: scope, acceptance criteria, and weekly cadence
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Samir Rao <samir@atlashealth.com>, Priya Desai <priya.desai@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed pilot scope and owners

Samir / Priya — thanks for a productive discovery call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before we build the pilot SOW: 

Scope summary (pilot, 6 weeks)
- Use case: guided triage assistant for front-line care coordinators (NLP + routing).
- Traffic profile: ~200 concurrent agents, average request size ~400 tokens, peak burst target ~600 rps for short windows.
- Integration: webhook for suggestions + embeddings-based rerank for knowledge base.

Success criteria (what Atlas will evaluate)
1) Latency: p95 inference latency < 300ms for standard 512-token window.
2) Availability: 99.5% uptime during business hours.
3) Quality: intent-match >= 88% on holdout set of 400 cases; top-1 suggestion accuracy >= 82%.
4) Cost guardrail: projected infra cost per 1M tokens < $120 (we'll publish estimate).

Owners & immediate asks
- Atlas: share holdout evaluation set (CSV) + security contact for questionnaire — Samir / Priya (action: send dataset link by Tue 5/18).
- Redwood: draft SOW + MAP, security evidence stub, integration runbook — Irene (deliver by 5/18).
- CS enablement & kickoff: Marissa to lead onboarding and success checkpoints.
- Infra/readiness (autoscale, burst policy): Karthik to propose runtime config and fallback policy.

Attachments: pilot_scope_and_success_criteria.pdf (attached), mutual_action_plan.xlsx (attached).

Immediate next steps
1) Atlas to confirm acceptance criteria & provide contact for security questionnaire by 5/18.
2) Redwood to send draft MAP & SOW (Irene) by 5/18.
3) Tentative kickoff: week of 5/24 — propose Tue 5/25 10am PT for a 45-min kick.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this started.

— Irene
Irene Choi
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Samir Rao <samir@atlashealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@atlashealth.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed pilot scope and owners

Irene — thanks for the clear summary. A few quick clarifications: 

• Security contact: that's me for now, but I'll loop in our infosec lead (Arun Verma) for the questionnaire. Can you attach a short list of evidence we should expect?
• Traffic: the 600 rps burst number is aggressive; can you propose a graceful fallback (degraded mode) if we hit sustained >400 rps? We want deterministic routing to a cheaper model if response times spike.
• Success metrics: the intent-match target looks good but we need an internal baseline to compare. I'll send a small sample of our 200-case holdout today.

Also — procurement will ask for an estimated not-to-exceed for the pilot. A ballpark number (including any reserved buffer) would help the internal review.

Samir
VP Product, Atlas Health
samir@atlashealth.com

Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 08:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed pilot scope and owners — updated MAP + security stub

Samir / Priya — thanks for the quick reply and the sample dataset; received it. A few updates attached and inline answers below.

1) Evidence checklist (attached as security_evidence_stub.txt) — contains a short inventory (SOC 2 type II report reference, logging/retention notes, and KMS options). Arun can use that as a starter. If he needs specific scans, loop Neha (cc'ed).
2) Fallback behavior: for sustained load >400 rps we will route inference to a quantized 8-bit variant with slightly higher latency but ~40% lower cost. We will also enable a short-lived circuit breaker after consecutive p95 breaches (Karthik will attach thresholds in the appendix).
3) Budget: pilot estimate (hosted) = $23k — this includes estimated token usage and a 20% buffer for bursts. If Atlas prefers dedicated capacity we can provide a dedicated quote (higher fixed commit, lower per-token).

Attachments: updated mutual_action_plan.xlsx (added milestone dates), pilot_scope_and_success_criteria.pdf (minor edits), security_evidence_stub.txt (attached).

Next actions:
- Atlas: confirm kickoff date and procurement contact for SOW by 5/20.
- Redwood: finalize SOW/DocuSign envelope and share MAP link (Irene).
